authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular ground-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Level 1.8 m trail with turn landmarks and constrained vegetation envelope; no steep drops or obscured exits. Roots and stones do not obstruct accessible default. Target bounding dimensions 32m wide x 0.3m high x 28m deep. Materials: soil-muted. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
